scope: 24 observations: Panel plus seven custom regions, across 2025-Q3, 2026-Q2 and 2026-Q3. Panel overlaps all regional rows; never sum both.

flow_comparison.csv.geography: Panel or one of seven custom regional groups
flow_comparison.csv.quarter: Quarter in YYYY-Qn format; three selected quarters, not a continuous time series
flow_comparison.csv.authorities: Included authority count; 253 across Panel and seven in Wales
flow_comparison.csv.received: Recorded applications received during the quarter
flow_comparison.csv.known_decisions: Recorded approval plus refusal decisions during the quarter; a separate event population from receipts
flow_comparison.csv.decisions_minus_receipts: known_decisions minus received. An activity balance, not a measured backlog change
flow_comparison.csv.known_decisions_per_100_receipts: 100 * known_decisions / received, rounded to six decimal places. Neither a cohort completion rate, approval probability nor speed measure

flow_change_decomposition.csv.geography: Panel or one of seven custom regional groups
flow_change_decomposition.csv.known_decision_change: Q3 2026 known decisions minus Q3 2025 known decisions
flow_change_decomposition.csv.balance_change: Q3 2026 decisions-minus-receipts minus Q3 2025 decisions-minus-receipts; exact sum of two contributions

missingness: No missing counts in selected input. Unknown outcomes are recorded categories, not an estimate of uncaptured records. Zero and missing are not interchangeable.
